ResourceHeader.Description:
The Interplanetary Magnetic Field (IMF) Sector Boundaries 1982–1988 dataset identifies the exact times when the large-scale magnetic polarity of the solar wind reversed. Available through the Wilcox Solar Observatory, this list documents sector boundary crossings using composite polarity distributions and in-situ spacecraft plasma and magnetic field observations.
Composite List: Daily polarity distributions identifying well-defined boundary patterns (such as ++++:---- or ++++---+--) .
Spacecraft List: Specific heliospheric current sheet crossings mapped from actual in-situ field and plasma measurements (Omnitape data).

Parameter.Name: Polarity indicators
Parameter.Description: The composite polarity (the computed daily polarity plus the inferred daily polarity replacing the missising data) daily polarity distributions by using a modified definition of the "well-defined" sector boundary. Here "+" refers to a UT day of outward polarity; "-" to a day of inward polarity and ":" to a day of mixed polarity.
